description: This file defines the ContactPhotoBinder class, a custom cursor binder used in an Android application to bind contact photos to list items by setting them as compound drawables on a TextView. It queries contact photos using the contact's ID and caches the images for efficiency.

classes.name: ContactPhotoBinder
classes.description: A custom cursor binder that binds contact photos to a TextView's compound drawable based on contact ID, using caching to improve performance.

methods.name: ContactPhotoBinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes resources, default drawable, cache, and photo size based on screen density.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a contact's photo to a view based on contact ID, with caching to optimize repeated lookups.
